title: 🚩 Kind of People You Find in Coffeemistry Islamabad Part 1
body: Someone explaining, completely unprompted, that they found this place through a friend, like it's a secret handshake and not a coffee shop with a Google listing. A man in eyeliner and a stack of rings ordering something with oat milk, dressed better than the entire room and fully aware of it. A random group breaking into song in a language nobody else at the tables speaks, and somehow it's not even the strangest thing happening right now. A laptop open to a blank document for the third hour straight. Outside, a street that can't fit one more car, yet somehow fits four Land Cruisers, two Prados, and a Lexus double parked like it's the owner's driveway.
caption:
Tag whoever told you about Coffeemistry "as a secret" 😭

title: 🚩 Kind of People You Find in Coffeemistry Islamabad Part 2
body: Someone doing a tarot reading for a friend at the corner table, cards fanned out next to a flat white, completely undisturbed by the room. A breakup happening loudly enough that the whole cafe is now quietly invested and nobody's pretending otherwise. A regular who brings their own reusable cup and makes sure you notice. A tiny unannounced open mic that six people in the room actually know is happening tonight. The barista who is clearly a musician moonlighting here, and someone always half-recognises them from somewhere and never says anything.
caption:
Tag the friend getting a tarot reading at a coffee shop like it's normal 😭 Part 3 coming 😭
